acip: DE GANG ZHIG, KHYOD KYI RTAGS KYIS DE SGRUB KYI DNGOS KYI BSGRUB BYA'I CHOS SU BZUNG BYA YANG YIN, MTSAN NYID KYANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN SRID, MTSON BYA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN SRID PA, KHYOD DE SGRUB KYI DON DANG THA SNYAD GNYIS KA SGRUB KYI RTAGS YANG DAG GI MTSAN NYID,
wylie: de gang zhig, khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi dngos kyi bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yang yin, mtshan nyid kyang yin pa'i gzhi mthun srid, mtshon bya yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun srid pa, khyod de sgrub kyi don dang tha snyad gnyis ka sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid
english: The definition of a correct reason for proving both the meaning and the term in any particular proof is as follows: Something which is both (1) the same as the first part above; and (2) which is such that there can exist one thing which is both (a) the explicit form of the thing considered the quality to be proven for the particular proof in which it serves as the reason, and (b) something which is a definition--and there can also exist one thing which is both (a) the same as part "a" above and (b) something which is a thing defined.
